user.title: Live Track Weather
user.description: Adds US weather alerts from the National Weather Service to the Live Track map. No location is needed: every active US alert is listed, and the map shows the ones on screen.

abort.already_configured: Live Track Weather is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Live Track Weather is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: Each poll downloads about 100 KB. The default, 180 seconds, is about 50 MB a day.
